entries.en: ollin: ashes or soot falling beneath the stove or hearth

entries.zh: 香；气味芳香，亦指焚香之香
entries.notes: M栏音调标记污损难辨（T99），据汉「香」与西栏 olor 互证定义。

entries.zh: 排草；排草香，随身佩带的香料草（马尼拉贸易香料）
entries.en: fragrant herb (p'ai-chhao, an aromatic grass); the scent one carries about
entries.notes: M栏次音污损难辨（T99），据汉「排草」与西栏 olor que traen consigo 定义。
M栏五音写中两处 T99 污损难辨，仅据汉「忘」与西栏 olividar/olvidarse 定忘却义。

entries.zh: 忽；一时急忘、仓促间疏忽忘却
entries.en: to forget in haste, to overlook in a hurry
entries.notes: M栏三处 T99 污损难辨，据汉「忽」与西栏 con la priesa 定急忘义。

entries.zh: 悸；惊悸失措、心悸忘其所以〔字存疑：悖/悸〕
entries.en: startled palpitation, to be startled out of one's wits (character uncertain: pei 'confused' vs ki 'palpitation')
entries.notes: 汉栏「悖/悸」存疑、西栏拼写缺损（consid/eryo），据音写 Que 较近「悸」义暂定惊悸。
M栏首音 T99 污损难辨，忘却义据汉「忘记」与西栏 oluidarse 互证。

entries.zh: 失收；落空、收成失收〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: loss, failure to collect (a harvest) 〔original damaged, gloss doubtful〕
entries.notes: 汉「失收」与西栏 olvidar 义项对应不明，官话栏空白，M栏首音污损，材料不足。

entries.zh: 荒废；荒疏久废、疏于照管而忘置
entries.en: to neglect, to let fall into disuse; to forget through disuse
entries.notes: M栏首音 T99 污损难辨，据汉「荒废」与西栏 oluidar se 定疏废义。

entries.zh: 落清；待人冷落、怠慢忘义〔字存疑：清/凊〕
entries.en: to treat with cold neglect, to forget one's obligations of courtesy (character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉栏「清/凊」存疑且 M 栏首音 T99 污损，西栏 of.le（oficio?）展开依赖推断。

entries.zh: 消化；消解消化，忧愁随之消散
entries.en: to digest; (fig.) to dissolve sorrow away
entries.notes: M栏次音 T99 污损且西栏拼写缺损，据汉「消化」暂释忧愁消解义。

entries.zh: 忘形骸；忘形失态、得意忘形
entries.en: to forget oneself, to lose all restraint (lit. forget one's bodily form)

entries.zh: 忘情；无动于衷、不念恩情
entries.en: to be unmoved, without feeling; to forget a kindness received
